meta.name: self-customize
meta.description: Customize your own agent — add capabilities, install packages, add MCP servers, edit code or CLAUDE.md. Use when the user asks you to add a feature, install a tool, or modify how you work. For non-trivial code changes, delegate to a builder agent via create_agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义你的智能体，添加功能、安装包或修改配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要按需调整智能体的能力和行为
copy.tagline_en: Customize your agent by adding capabilities, packages, or modifying configs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to tailor your agent's abilities and behavior on demand

howto.what: 装上后,克劳德可以自己改装自己:直接改写记忆和长期指令,添加 MCP 服务器,安装 apt/npm 软件包;涉及源码的重大改动不亲自动手,而是交给专门的 builder 小助手完成,下次重启时生效。
howto.when: 当用户要求它添加功能、安装工具,或修改它的工作方式时触发;装系统包、接 MCP 服务器、改源码等需求,会走对应流程。

say.text: 帮我把 ffmpeg 装上,我之后要转录音频
say.note: 会触发安装流程,需要管理员批准

say.text: 以后每次回答前先告诉我你会分几步做
say.note: 写入长期指令,之后一直生效

say.text: 帮我加一个读取 RSS 的工具
say.note: 先找现成 MCP 服务器,没有再交给 builder 写

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can customize its own environment: edit its memory/instructions, add MCP servers, install apt/npm packages, or delegate non-trivial source-code changes to a builder agent. Changes take effect on next restart.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a feature, install a tool, or modify how Claude works. Applies to package installs, MCP server additions, and source-code changes; package/MCP changes need admin approval.

say_en.text: Install ffmpeg so I can transcribe audio later.
say_en.note: Triggers the install flow; admin approval required.

say_en.text: From now on, tell me your plan before every answer.
say_en.note: Written into long-term instructions and persists.

say_en.text: Add a tool for reading RSS feeds.
say_en.note: Looks for an existing MCP server first, else delegates to a builder.
